name: Page Table Size / Multilevel Address Split
recognitionClueHinglish: VA bits, PA bits, page size, PTE size di hain aur page table ka size, levels, ya kisi level ki bits poochi hain — sabse bada pattern (43 me se 18).
whatShouldComeToMind: Offset = log2(page size); page number bits = VA - offset.
Ek page me PTE count = page size / PTE size, yahi bits per level hain.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Offset, page number, frame bits nikaalo.
2. Single level: entries x PTE size.
3. Multilevel: bits per level = log2(page size/PTE size); levels = ceil(page-number bits / bits per level).
4. Asked quantity (table size, #levels, memory for a process) compute karo.
variationsObserved: Maximum page-table size ke andar page count back-solve karna.

name: Effective Access Time (TLB, page faults)
recognitionClueHinglish: Hit ratio, TLB time, memory time, page fault service time diye hain aur EAT poocha hai.
whatShouldComeToMind: Probability tree banao: TLB hit / TLB miss / page fault.
Fault rate p ka weightage service time se hota hai.
generalSolvingApproach: 2. Har path ki probability se multiply karke sum lo.
variationsObserved: Multilevel table + TLB combined (miss pe levels+1 accesses).
Dirty page ka extra write-back time.
commonTraps: TLB lookup time ko miss path me add karna bhool jaana.

name: TLB Organization (tag bits / size)
recognitionClueHinglish: TLB entries, associativity, VA bits di hain aur TLB tag ya size poochi hai.
whatShouldComeToMind: Tag = page number bits - set-index bits.
generalSolvingApproach: 3. Tag bits = page number - index; entry size me tag + frame + control bits.

name: Conceptual / Definitions
recognitionClueHinglish: True/false ya match-the-following: virtual memory ke advantages, page table content, swap space, MMU responsibilities, hardware support.
whatShouldComeToMind: Virtual memory protected address spaces deti hai, program ko RAM se bada hone deti hai.
Multilevel page table memory bachata hai, access time nahi.
generalSolvingApproach: 2. Har option ko definition se check karo.
variationsObserved: Segmented paging me segment table ka page table.
commonTraps: 'Multilevel table access time kam karta hai' galat hai — memory footprint kam karta hai.
